values.note: 20 sites in the US 221 Access Drive-To Campground, all electric (10 full hookup); two are numbered 008 - H and 014-H. Every site is a back-in; listed equipment/driveway lengths run 33 to 67 ft, most 38-55 ft.

values.note: Booking page: electric campsites 'can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival. Front gate locked at posted closing time (6-10 p.m. by month); no entry after.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/new-river-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552859 (Booking Window for Campsite Electric; 'Business rules for Holiday Weekends'; gate alert), read 2026-10-22

note: Drive-to campground at the park's US 221 Access; the park's other campgrounds are walk-in or paddle-in only. Half the sites have full hookups. The dump station charges a fee. Vehicle GPS units misplace the park address: navigate to 36.46768,-81.34035 (the booking site's advice). --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric with full hookups (10 of 20), 20 back-in sites, showers/flush toilets/dump/water, ReserveAmerica booking; all accesses OPEN on ncparks.gov (no Helene closure). Changed max_rig_ft 33 -> 67 (listed lengths 33-67 ft; 33 was the shortest). Added pull_through false, year-round status, 6-month window, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days. Fees ($35 / $45 incl. $3 nightly reservation fee, read 2026-10-12) stand. Not stated: walk-up sites, max stay.
flags: Registry state:NC holiday min_stay waiver says 7 days; the ReserveAmerica booking page here says the minimum drops to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival (as at Kerr Lake 103 and Cliffs of the Neuse 4214). Recorded 14.

ncparks.gov has no camping page for New River (no /camping URL in the sitemap); the booking site is the only per-campground source. The entry name 'New River State Park' covers only the 'US 221 Access Drive-To Campground' (ReserveAmerica's loop name); consider naming it so.
Sites 008 - H and 014-H carry an -H suffix (probably camp host) but are listed like the others; counted in the 20.
